The Challenge

Dream Talks had great conversations, but the content wasn't posted consistently across Instagram or YouTube, so reach and engagement stayed low on both platforms.

Our Approach

We broke each episode into short clips and handled editing, graphics, captions, and posting to keep content flowing regularly across Instagram and YouTube. Instagram hit 706K views and 534K accounts reached (+336.7% profile activity), while YouTube picked up 157.2K views and 1.2K watch hours in 28 days, with Shorts driving a 74.6% watch-through rate.

Podcast · Long Form · Clips

Hind Stories — 6× audience growth in 4 months

Hind Stories came to us with a great concept but no content system. We built their entire podcast production pipeline from scratch — strategy, recording, post-production, YouTube uploads, and Instagram clip repurposing.

Within 4 months, their monthly listeners grew 6× — from 2,000 to over 12,000 — without spending a single rupee on paid ads.

“Littroi completely transformed how we produce our podcast. Growth went beyond what we imagined — and they handled every single detail.”

— Hind Stories Team

SaaS Video · Product Demo

13Dreams — 40K views and 200+ leads from one video

13Dreams needed a product demo that didn't just explain their software — it needed to sell it. We scripted, produced, and edited a single hero demo video with clear hooks, benefit-led storytelling, and a strong CTA.

That one video generated 40,000 views and over 200 qualified inbound leads in its first 60 days — outperforming their entire previous 6 months of marketing.

Brand · Social Media · Video

Hair Rescue — 280% organic reach increase in 3 months

Hair Rescue had a great product but an inconsistent digital presence. We rebuilt their brand identity, created a repeatable video content strategy, and took over their social media management entirely.

The result: a 280% increase in organic reach, a refreshed professional look, and a content system they can scale indefinitely.

“Littroi completely transformed how we produce our podcast. Growth went beyond what we imagined — and they handled every single detail.”


— Hind Stories Team

Long Form · YouTube

TDE — 0 to 15K YouTube subscribers in 6 months

TDE had no YouTube presence. We built their channel from zero — scripting, shooting, and editing weekly long-form videos with a consistent brand voice and SEO-driven titles.

Six months later: 15,000 subscribers and a growing community that keeps coming back every week.
